              In this class, students try to create new media for social innovaiton and learn about skills for that. To achive SDGs, we should not leverage only our skills, but also various stakeholders' skills. Learing objective of this class is getting a method to think about SDGs and how to involve various stakeholder with new media.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this class, students will try to make revolution of education by their media. Media means gamification material. Students will play some existing gamification materials and find the best way to share SDGs knowledge with high school students.
